generation.uuid_policy: Generated UUIDs are nondeterministic. Regeneration creates a different fixture identity and requires new hashes, role ledger and calibration; never reuse these hashes for different bytes.

prerequisites.gui_lease: BLOCKED/QUEUED: coordinator only; no Shading/HVAC desktop access authorized in this phase.
prerequisites.desktop_identity: Require the coordinator's explicit lease and the authorized private-profile notebook/actor/active-console identity plus pinned tools. Never infer the GUI actor from the SSH transport account.
prerequisites.input_path: UNKNOWN: confirm the official simulator can set this block's registered input connectors without hardware or private ABI calls.
prerequisites.native_instance: UNKNOWN: bind this fixture and this class's primary COL/vtable/+0x50 independently. Energy runtime class IDs and frame pointers are not portable evidence.
prerequisites.initial_position: UNKNOWN: establish a visible normalized mid-travel position of 0.50 +/- 0.05 through official simulation controls only; do not write application memory.
prerequisites.clock: UNKNOWN: record official simulator elapsed time, real-time scaling, reset/restart semantics and timing-parameter units without changing the OS clock.
prerequisites.sampling: UNKNOWN: interlock timing requires an approved official observation path with intervals no larger than 0.10 seconds. Coarse screenshots cannot prove an all-cycle interlock.
prerequisites.hardware: No devices, sensors or actuators are fabricated. If bare block inputs cannot execute, record the actual missing dependencies and block the cases.

clock_plan.clock: official simulator elapsed seconds, contingent on calibration

cases.setup: Verify all pinned private hashes and desktop identity. Import a disposable copy, select the block and inspect its registered connector labels before saving.
cases.inputs: No movement command until official input injection, direction meanings and clock have been calibrated.
cases.clock: Record start/stop/restart and elapsed-time evidence, with bounded calibration under the wall-time cap.
cases.procedure: Save/reopen unchanged, then make one independently chosen timing edit and restore it. Compare all 21 connector keys/order, UUIDs, room/page references, chosen scalar settings and all untouched XML. Identify any delegated advanced-settings dialog without modifying unknown records.
cases.limitations: PROPOSED storage/admission hypothesis only. GUI repairs, unresolved native prerequisites or inadequate timing evidence block later cases.

cases.setup: Fresh admitted fixture; mid-travel position calibrated; all registered digital commands inactive; Type meaning and timing units recorded.
cases.clock: Observe through official elapsed second 5.0; maximum sample interval 0.10 seconds.
cases.limitations: PROPOSED, not an implemented specification. The configured blocking interval is 0.5 with sampling tolerance. Missing positive movement/native progress or coarse observations make the result incomplete. EndUp/EndDown are full-travel commands, not proven physical end-stop sensors.

cases.setup: Fresh admitted fixture; mid-travel position and actual movement calibrated; other commands inactive.
cases.clock: Read official outputs at elapsed seconds 2.5 and 3.5 after independently observing movement.
cases.limitations: PROPOSED settling and normalized-position hypothesis only; does not prove end-stop, motor, lamella, weather, safety or physical interlock behavior.
